title: Eclipse Mindscape
description: A surreal portrait of a woman whose head merges with a dystopian cityscape, set against a desert of ancient ruins. Her right eye is a swirling black void, the left a spiral; colorful dripping paint, pixelated patterns, floating hearts, and a solar eclipse with a golden pyramid dominate the cosmic sky above.
prompt: Surreal digital painting of a woman's bust in a desert landscape with ancient stone ruins. Her head is a swirling cityscape with buildings and roads, one eye is a swirling black hole, the other a red spiral. Dripping colorful paint, pixel details, floating hearts, and a red and black solar eclipse with a glowing golden pyramid in the dark cosmic sky. Psychedelic melting elements, rich textures, cinematic surrealism.
